overclaim.label: overclaim
overclaim.target: A synthetic pilot (4,000 trials per cell, $N=7$ verifiers, f=2 captured) already tests the prediction and yields a nuanced result: trust-score weighting beats plain majority under prompt-injection capture (accuracy 0.69 vs. 0.34 at honest accuracy 0.6; 0.94 vs. 0.74 at 0.8), because calibration-phase trust identifies deterministically flipped verifiers; under majority-bias mimicry, however, the same method fails (0.32 vs. 0.41 at honest accuracy 0.6). These pilot values are synthetic and do not establish a universal impossibility result.
